validation_endpoint_bank.replacement_rule: Append the next contiguous 1024-seed chunk until both endpoint ESS fractions are at least 0.20; never change the target.

threshold_rule.phi_maximum_standardized_error: max(0.10, 3 times the 95th percentile of direct-SI split maximum errors)
threshold_rule.raw_mmd2: 4 times the 95th percentile of direct-SI split raw-field MMD2
threshold_rule.downsampled_mmd2: 4 times the 95th percentile of direct-SI split downsampled-field MMD2
threshold_rule.integration_convergence: 256-step integrated MMD2 must improve by less than 20 percent relative to 128 steps, or the discrepancy is classified as ODE-sensitive

sweep.status: variants will be frozen in a separate protocol after the v7 checkpoint and FM-target audits, before any v8 training
